Page_ProjectDto.description:
The 12-key envelope of every v1 list (`BasePaginator`): the page's rows, how many there are in all, how many pages, and the
cursors of the next and the previous page. The pin's schema has one per resource (`PaginatedProjectResponse`, ...), which differ
only in what `results` holds.

grouped_by.description: Always `null`: a v1 list is not grouped. The key is always there (`required`), whatever it holds.

items.description:
The pin's `ProjectSerializer`: 43 keys, and `sort_order` besides when the caller's place in the list is part of the answer. The pin
counts cycles and modules; Thrust has neither, so both are 0 (a deviation the register carries, D-030 (1)), and no deploy board
exists. A key whose value can be `null` here is `Option`, which is what the document says of it (the pin's schema calls some of
these non-nullable and sends `null` all the same: EX-006).

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted project is not shown.

sort_order.description:
Present in a list and absent from one project: the caller's place among the project's members, `null` for a person who has
none (the outer `Option` is whether the key is there, the inner one what it holds).

Page_StateDto.description:
The 12-key envelope of every v1 list (`BasePaginator`): the page's rows, how many there are in all, how many pages, and the
cursors of the next and the previous page. The pin's schema has one per resource (`PaginatedProjectResponse`, ...), which differ

items.description:
The pin's `StateSerializer`: 18 keys. `is_triage` is whether the group is the intake's, which a state of the list never is (the pin
stores it apart from the group, and a request can set it on a state of another group: the register carries that). A key whose value
can be `null` here is `Option`, which is what the document says of it.

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted state is not shown.

slug.description:
The pin's `slugify` of the name ([`crate::states::slugify`]): it can be empty, for a name with no letter or digit that NFKD
leaves in ASCII, which is what the pin answers too.

PatchedProjectUpdateRequest.description:
What a project's change takes (the pin's `ProjectUpdateSerializer`): the creation's keys, none required, and the two ids that a
change can set.

PatchedStateRequest.description: What a state's change takes: the creation's keys, none required.

ProjectCreateRequest.description:
What a project's creation takes (the pin's `ProjectCreateSerializer`). `description` and the two switches are optional and not
nullable; the ids and the texts that can be `null` are `Option`.

StateRequest.description:
What a state's creation takes (the pin's `StateSerializer` as a request): `name` and `color` are required, the rest is optional, and
only the two external keys can be `null`.
